They took the back seat out of an M5. Not the whole thing — the three-seat
bench is gone and in its place are two individual buckets, like a four-seat
coupe. In a car whose entire point is that it's a saloon.
627 horsepower, which made it the most powerful production BMW at the time.
Ten more than the M5 Competition, which is almost beside the point.
230 pounds lighter than the Competition, and some of that is sound
deadening they deliberately deleted. Carbon fibre bonnet, mirrors, diffuser
and rear spoiler.
42,995 new — nearly thirty thousand more than the Competition it's based
on, for ten horsepower and less soundproofing.

scenes.headline: 627 hp
scenes.narration: How about 627 horsepower in a luxury sedan? That's the 2022 BMW M5 CS. It's no ordinary four-door.

scenes.headline: Unique Interior

Not cheap—$142,000 new and about $172,233 today. It’s gone up in value! Rare for BMW sedans. BMW sedans rarely appreciate like this one has.

scenes.narration: Top speed capped at 155 miles per hour. But it’s the journey, not the destination, right?
So, does a sedan need four buckets, or is that just lavish? Would you daily it?

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2022 BMW M5 CS, finished in Brands Hatch Grey Metallic with a Black and Mugello Red interior. According to the Monroney Label provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes an electronic transfer case with rear-wheel and all-wheel-drive modes, adaptive suspension, auto-dimming and power-folding side mirrors, 16-speaker Harman/Kardon stereo system, and more as detailed below. The seller mentions no modifications. The "F90" M5 CS is the first CS version of the M5. The increased use of carbon fiber and other lightweight materials resulted in a 256-pound diet over the regular F90 M5. It wears a special trim called "Gold Bronze," which is visible on the wheels and grille surrounds. The M5 CS also boasts an increase in horsepower with a 2.8 second 0 to 60 mph time and an electronically limited top speed of 155 miles per hour. Power comes from a 4.4-liter turbocharged V8 engine, which produces 627 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Power is sent to all four or the rear wheels via an 8-speed transmission.
sections.Equipment: A Monroney Label is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: 20-inch BMW Style 798M wheels Electronic transfer case with rear-wheel and all-wheel-drive modes 3.15 rear axle ratio Double wishbone front suspension Adaptive tuned suspension with driver control functionality Auto-dimming and power-folding side-view mirrors Laser supplement auto-leveling headlights LED brake lights M carbon bucket front seats with 10-way power adjustment Remote engine start 600w, 16-speaker Harman/Kardon stereo system Wi-fi hotspot Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
sections.Seller Notes: There is a loan on this vehicle. Sale proceeds will be used to satisfy the loan and allow the seller to transfer the title to the winning bidder. Please contact the seller directly with any questions. The seller reports that the scratch on the splitter occured during transport from Germany.
